content:
sam: Candidate Priya arriving early AM, visa queue might slow her down. Can we push start to 11:00 and reserve a quiet room for a quick check-in + Zoom test? Need laptop loaner, charger, and a transit stipend note. cc @maya
maya: I can move the panels to 11:00. Which rooms should I block?
sam: Quiet Room C and Conference B as backup. Add 15m between loops for debriefs. Also dietary: dairy-free.
it-ops-bot: Loaner request received. Please confirm OS image.
maya: Linux image is fine. @it-ops-bot please label loaner "Priya - Candidate" and set VPN creds expiry 48h.
it-ops-bot: Done. VPN creds will be staged at Reception.
recruiter-bot: Transit stipend approved $40. Candidate should keep receipt and use: https://redwood.internal/expenses/candidate. Submit within 14 days.
sam: Thanks all. I'll DM ETA updates. If she's delayed past noon we'll convert first loop to remote.
maya: Noted. I'll update calendar invites and ping interviewers. :thumbsup:
